title: REQ · UI store holds drawer and modal state with toggleDrawer, openModal and closeModal
summary: Drawer and modal state and actions in useUiStore
description: Context: no UI store exists. Desired behavior: uiStore.ts is a Zustand store with drawerOpen (boolean) and modal (ModalId or null), plus toggleDrawer, openModal(id) and closeModal. Expected result: components can drive the drawer and modal from one store. Why: the mobile drawer and contribution modal need shared state.
acceptance_criteria: Given a fresh store, when read, then drawerOpen is false and modal is null
Given the store, when toggleDrawer is called twice, then drawerOpen goes true then false
Given the store, when openModal('contribution') is called and then closeModal, then modal is 'contribution' then null

preserve: Existing GameLayout local state until a later wiring task

definition_of_done: State and actions exist and are typed
